name: RetSend
summary: Sends and receives files over local Wi-Fi between a Knulli handheld and any LocalSend peer.

notes: RetSend 1.0.0 is the upstream Knulli release, authorized for experimental installation on any Knulli device with matching aarch64 glibc, SDL2, and libc. Device lists and display bounds are advisory. The owner confirmed this version tested on TrimUI Smart Pro, Knulli, aarch64, 1280x720 on 2026-10-25. Approval provenance and experimental safety-review status are unchanged.

The stable package ID and destination are retained so fork installations can update in place. The upstream tools/ prefix stays inside /userdata/roms/tools/RetSend to avoid colliding with the fork's retsend file. The archive's gamelist.xml and image remain package-local; the Store owns only one entry in the shared gamelist.

GitHub reports v1.0.0 as not immutable. The Store pins the accepted bytes by exact compressed size, installed size, and SHA-256 before extraction. Source evidence pins tag commit 7968a92c1f751521ac426397c87cea146cb769b0.

The archive contains five regular files and three directory entries, with no links, special files, traversal, or duplicate paths. Only Retsend.sh and retsend/retsend receive execute mode. The upstream ZIP does not ship LICENSE or third-party notices; source licensing and the missing bundled notices are disclosed, not treated as resolved.

A same-length, byte-checked staging patch changes only the launcher's export block to retain /userdata/system/configs/retsend for configuration, history, and TLS identity, and /userdata/roms/retsend-inbox as the default receive directory. Both survive update, repair, and uninstall. Existing settings and user-selected receive routes can override the default inbox.

HOME and XDG_DATA_HOME stay in the package-local retsend directory. Logs and SDL preferences are unmanaged runtime files there. The upstream ES InvertButtons mapping, back-to-quit behavior, and binary are unchanged. The launcher uses no remote installer or PortMaster helper. Upstream browser roots are not a filesystem sandbox.

LAN discovery uses UDP 53317; HTTPS transfers use self-signed peer certificates and TCP 53317 with fallback ports. Configuration permits HTTP. Only the reviewed upstream ZIP is downloaded by the Store.

Security limits remain: no authenticated TLS peer pinning, no explicit restrictive private-key mode, no symlink-safe rooted receive writes or storage quota, overwrite enabled by default, and no signed immutable release, attestation, or per-crate SBOM. These block verified status.
The binary requires glibc 2.28 and SDL 2.0.18 or later for SDL_RenderGeometry. Detection confirms SDL2 presence, not its version. Other device matrices still need testing.

evidence.note: Owner reconfirmed all current apps working and tested on TSP. Uses the previously confirmed Knulli AArch64 1280x720 TSP matrix; separate lifecycle results were not supplied.
Owner confirmed all seven current versions tested on TrimUI Smart Pro only. Separate lifecycle steps were not reported.
Upstream LocalSend-compatible client. Release v1.0.0 publishes a dedicated Knulli ZIP.

Downloaded ZIP: 4,338,763 compressed bytes, 8,327,533 extracted regular-file bytes, SHA-256 dbe0a9c9a04dc9f5c541f6bfa822ed1868443a52ca1bd6f836582195b7808195. Inventory: tools/Retsend.sh, tools/Retsend.sh.keys, tools/gamelist.xml, tools/images/retsend.png, tools/retsend/retsend.
Publisher checksum agrees with the downloaded archive and GitHub asset digest. No separate archive inventory is published.
Exact v1.0.0 tag commit; Cargo.lock in the same tree records dependencies.
GPL-3.0 source license. Unlike the fork, the upstream Knulli ZIP omits the license text and notices; this remains a packaging limitation.
Upstream credits dependencies and fonts, including Nunito under SIL OFL 1.1. The Knulli ZIP does not include third-party notices or a per-crate SBOM.

Original 914-byte launcher reviewed against the ZIP. Staging patches bytes 610..857, preserving length and requiring final SHA-256 85070aacb3c1bc0c9136f8458cce79ccfe34089f471b33f3f480e54f67d50092, to retain the existing config and default inbox paths.

Downloaded ELF inspection: AArch64 PIE, interpreter /lib/ld-linux-aarch64.so.1, NEEDED libSDL2-2.0.so.0, libc.so.6, libm.so.6, libdl.so.2, libpthread.so.0; highest GLIBC symbol 2.28. Build links system SDL2 and checks the glibc floor.
Persistent identity uses the selected data directory; private-key writes do not explicitly enforce restrictive permissions. Outbound client.rs disables certificate verification.
Receive writes use ordinary directory creation, file creation, and rename rather than rooted no-follow operations. Transfer defaults in config/transfer.rs enable overwrite and auto-routing.
Evaluation request for RetSend on Knulli. It records that the upstream UI assumes gamepad labels and 640x480 scaling, and that controller adaptation and per-device matrices still need direct testing.

install.warning: Unverified experimental test on this device. RetSend needs local Wi-Fi, keeps its configuration and TLS identity in /userdata/system/configs/retsend, and receives files in /userdata/roms/retsend-inbox. Both stay after uninstall.
